More Details

This dataset contains MCES owned/operated water resource recovery facilities (WRRF), which treat wastewater conveyed by the MCES regional wastewater system, yo provide a spatial data inventory to aid maintenance, planning and analysis efforts. 

The dataset does not contain specific buildings or tanks within the plants, but rather serves as a general location for the plant.
